children: SVF II Meerkat (DE) LLC, owned by the SoftBank Group Corp through SoftBank Vision Fund, has sold more than Rs 1,650 crore worth shares in Meesho, the Bengaluru-based e-commerce company, via open market transactions.
As per the block deals published on the National Stock Exchange, the SoftBank entity sold 8 crore equity shares, representing 1.73 percent of paid-up equity via two transactions.
The Meesho shares worth Rs 1,650.4 crore exchanged by the company among several domestic and overseas investors at a price of Rs 206.3 per share.
SVF II Meerkat (DE) LLC had held 8.6 percent stake or 39.63 crore shares in Meesho as per the shareholding pattern of June 2026.

Global investors including Morgan Stanley, Fidelity Investments, Goldman Sachs, Manulife Investment Management, Norges Bank on account of the Government Pension Fund Global, Social Protection Fund, Copthall Mauritius Investment, BofA Securities, Dendana Investments (Mauritius), Ghisallo Master Fund, and Integrated Core Strategies Asia, Kuwait Investment Authority, Societe Generale, and Susquehanna Pacific were buyers for shares sold by the SoftBank entity.

Domestic institutional investors like Franklin Templeton MF, HDFC Standard Life Insurance, HSBC MF, Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance, Canara Robeco MF, Bajaj Life Insurance, and Motilal Oswal AMC also acquired shares from SVF II Meerkat.
Meesho shares fell 0.88 percent to end at Rs 209.74 on the National Stock Exchange.
DSDG Holding sells 1.4% stake in Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions

DSDG Holding ApS, an affiliate of Danish Sustainable Development Goals Investment Fund managed by IFU, sold 16.33 lakh shares, representing 1.39 percent of paid-up equity, for Rs 199.3 crore at a price of Rs 1,220 per share. This was out of its total shareholding of 1.82 percent in CleanMax as of June 2026.

All the shares sold by DSDG were acquired by marquee institutional investors like SBI Life Insurance, Mahindra Manulife Mutual Fund, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, DSP India Fund, and WhiteOak Capital MF.
The stock saw a strong gap-up opening, may by post the above block deals, and ended 3.27 percent higher at Rs 1,298.7 on the NSE despite profit booking at higher levels.
Meera Goyal buys Rs 31 crore worth units in Knowledge Realty Trust from IIFL Management
Meera Goyal has acquired 28.31 lakh units (0.06 percent stake) in Knowledge Realty Trust, from IIFL Management Services, for Rs 31 crore at a price of Rs 109.5 per unit.

title: Block Deals: SoftBank offloads Rs 1,650 crore worth shares in Meesho; DSDG Holding sells 1.4% stake in Clean Max Enviro Energy
